title: Michael Svendsen — Systems Publications
description: Production analytics, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and open-source AI tooling by Michael Svendsen.

items.title: Architecting a Resilient E-Commerce Analytics Engine: Snowflake, dbt & The Single Source of Truth for Autonomous Agents
items.summary: When building high-volume e-commerce platforms, bolting AI agents onto disparate data stores creates fatal metric dissonance. Here is how to engineer a production-grade analytics foundation using Snowflake and dbt that cuts query times by 50% while serving as the authoritative single source of truth for both merchant dashboards and autonomous AI agents.

items.title: SPYPOINT MCP: Bridging Cellular Trail-Camera Telemetry with AI Vision Agents
items.summary: Trail cameras capture thousands of photos, but turning raw cellular photo streams into actionable field intelligence requires more than simple image downloads. Here is how I engineered an open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for SPYPOINT cellular cameras—featuring burst clustering algorithms that group 146 photos into 14 distinct visits, strict read-only safety guardrails, and automated contact sheet generation.

items.title: Architecting LiteMCP: Bringing Model Context Protocol to Cloudflare Workers
items.summary: Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP) revolutionizes how LLMs interact with external tools and data, but official SDKs rely heavily on Node.js internals like stdio, net, and child_process. Here is how I architected LiteMCP—a high-performance, edge-native TypeScript framework designed specifically for Cloudflare Workers with zero cold starts, Web Standards SSE streaming, and full JSON-RPC 2.0 compliance.

items.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration with AWS Bedrock AgentCore: Autonomous Storefront Optimization
items.summary: Most enterprise AI features remain bolted-on chatbots generating dead text that cannot mutate state. In this architectural deep dive, we examine how to orchestrate autonomous multi-agent systems using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and CopilotKit for a high-volume mobile e-commerce platform—turning high-level merchant directives into live, verified storefront layouts with zero server management.

items.title: Automating GGUF Quantization: Bridging Hugging Face Transformers to Local Runtimes
items.summary: While open-source inference engines like llama.cpp and Ollama have democratized local LLMs, converting raw Hugging Face checkpoints into production-grade GGUF binaries remains a minefield of broken tokenizers, out-of-memory crashes on sharded safetensors, and ad-hoc quantization flags. Here is how I built GGUF-n-Go to fully automate end-to-end model quantization and multi-precision matrix deployment.

items.title: Designing a High-Frequency Motorsport Telemetry SDK: Reverse-Engineering & Type-Safe Architecture in TypeScript
items.summary: Sim racing telemetry powers real-time driver coaching, team endurance race strategy, and championship analytics. But iRacing's REST API is notorious for aggressive rate limits, asynchronous two-step S3 pre-signed downloads, and shifting JSON schemas. Here is how I architected iracing-data-sdk in TypeScript to provide bulletproof token-bucket throttling, rolling session management, and end-to-end type safety.

items.title: Binary Stream Parsing & Perceptual Color Extraction: Building @mikesven/gif-parser
items.summary: Most image processing in JavaScript depends on native C++ bindings like Sharp or libvips, which fail inside lightweight serverless isolates like Cloudflare Workers. Here is how I engineered @mikesven/gif-parser: a zero-dependency TypeScript engine that parses raw GIF87a/89a binary byte streams using DataView and implements CIELAB Delta-E color science for perceptually accurate palette extraction.

items.title: Deploying a High-Resolution Photography Platform: SST Ion, Cloudflare Pages, and Edge Caching
items.summary: Displaying fine-art wildlife and astrophotography on the web requires balancing 45-megapixel raw fidelity with sub-second page loads on mobile devices. Here is how I architected photography.mikesvendsen.net using SST Ion, Cloudflare Pages, static manifest extraction, and responsive AVIF/WebP srcset generation—delivering a zero-database gallery with global edge caching.
